package.name: aav_drive_to_point
package.description: Drive to one GPS or map point and stop there: the launch file (drive_to_point.launch.py), the config (drive_to_point.yaml) and the maths in Python with no ROS (approach.py, line.py, drive.py, rules.py, run.py; aav_track imports the first two). The action server point_driver and its client are aav_drive_to_point_rs's; the Python ones were removed on 22 Nov 2026.
